items.title: Sandia VASt model predicts complex alloy properties with small training datasets
participants: Sandia National Laboratories (Matthew Barry and colleagues)
Stevens Institute of Technology (paper author affiliation)
items.what_changed: New Sandia feature describes VASt predictions for high-entropy alloys using tens of training samples and electron-density representations. The underlying journal paper appeared June 16, 2026; this is new laboratory reporting, not a newly published paper.
items.significance: Potentially reduces training-data and simulation costs for materials design. Experimental validation and generalization beyond evaluated alloys remain work in progress.
items.affiliation_evidence: Sandia release and underlying paper identify LDRD and other support without Genesis attribution. Checked official July award roster, repository 297-project registry, Sandia Genesis project announcement, and targeted VASt/Barry/Genesis searches. Shared materials themes and Sandia participation do not establish a documented project connection.
items.deduplication_note: Not in current 45-item repository/live archive or accessible review records. Distinct from approved Sandia AIGM Lite article.
items.summary: Sandia reports that VASt predicts high-entropy alloy properties from small training datasets using electron-density representations. Experimental validation and broader generalization remain in progress. GENESIS LINK NOT CONFIRMED.

items.title: Dakota 7.0 adds Python API for automated scientific studies
participants: Sandia National Laboratories Dakota development team
items.what_changed: Released Dakota 7.0 with a Python API spanning uncertainty quantification, calibration, optimization and surrogate models; release explicitly describes embedding studies in agentic AI workflows.
items.significance: Makes established scientific analysis methods directly callable from automation and agent workflows. This is enabling software, not a demonstrated autonomous-discovery result.
items.affiliation_evidence: Official release documents agentic-workflow capability but no Genesis project affiliation. Targeted DOE/Sandia searches and repository project-registry checks did not establish linkage. Dakota State University quantum-circuit project is a different entity and is not evidence for this software.
items.deduplication_note: Not present in accessible archive/review records; materially distinct software capability.
items.summary: Dakota 7.0 introduces a Python API that embeds uncertainty quantification, optimization and related studies in automated scientific applications and agentic workflows. GENESIS LINK NOT CONFIRMED.

suppressed.reason: Compared full articles: same author, hardware specifications, memory increase, model count, quotes, ChemGraph and SYNAPS-I demonstration. November 18 release condenses November 4 reporting; no substantive new development identified.

findings: Repository frontend sorts news using gih_added_at, then gih_added_date, then legacy date; displays Added and Published separately when gih_added_date exists.
Collector merge does not assign first-added timestamps, sorts archive by date, and can discard timestamps on unreviewed refreshed records.
D1 editorial table preserves existing added timestamps with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, but only for inputs that supply them.
Live JavaScript retrieval returned 403, so actual rendered dashboard date/sorting not verified in this run.
